patch_description: Crossover strategy: the slow stochastic hill-climb / geometric polish loops (17s runtime, score 0.72) are replaced by the much faster and higher-scoring softmax-barycentric Powell optimization (score 0.76, ~15s). I combine the best parts of both: (1) the vectorized triplet-area computation and guaranteed-feasible softmax parametrization from the inspiration program; (2) the top-k softmin objective from the current program, which focuses the smooth surrogate on the ~20 binding (smallest) triplet areas instead of diluting the gradient over all 165 triples — this sharpens convergence; (3) a slightly wider deterministic multi-start set (hand-crafted barycentric seed + fixed-seed random logits); (4) a short gradient-informed perpendicular polish only as a cheap final touch-up (kept only if it improves), and a barycentric repair/validity check with hardcoded fallback for robustness. Temperature annealing over three scales (relative to the triangle area) lets Powell first smooth the landscape then sharpen to the true min. This keeps runtime near the faster parent while aiming for a higher min-area.
